what: a toxic jelly: one single heaped mass of thick, wet, see-through bright lime-green jelly, a great quivering heap, painted with depth. It is a low, wide, rounded mound, wider than it is tall, with a smooth sagging skin, and at its front one thick rounded lip of jelly lifts and curls forward. Light shines through it everywhere: the edges are pale and bright, the middle is a deeper green, bright white wet highlights run along its curves, and a few big round bubbles hang inside it. Sunk inside the middle of the jelly, half dissolved, float a few small pale skulls of the vermin it has eaten. It is only jelly and the loose bones inside it.
colours: bright see-through lime-green jelly with deeper leaf-green depths and pale yellow-green and white wet highlights, a few small pale cream skulls inside it.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: The mound surges to the left, its front lip lifted and curling forward over empty air, about to fold down, the rest of it sagging heavy and low behind.
must_show: one low heaped mound of bright lime-green jelly, front lip lifted and curling
wet, glassy, see-through painted jelly with depth, bright not dark
a few small pale skulls sunk inside it
no face at all

what: an ochre jelly: one single thick, heavy, wet heap of dull mustard-yellow slime, a cave ooze painted with depth and weight. It is a low, wide, lumpy, sagging heap, wider than it is tall, made of three uneven lobes of different sizes slumped against each other, and from its front one thick blunt arm of the same slime, as thick as a man's leg, rears up and curls over. Its skin is wet, wrinkled and cloudy, not clean: darker brown-amber clots and streaks hang inside it, thick drips sag down its sides, and long pale wet highlights run along its folds. It eats flesh and leather but cannot eat metal: riding on top of the heap, half sunk into the slime and tilted, is one dented grey steel soldier's helmet, clean and uneaten. It is only slime and the helmet caught in it.
colours: dull mustard-yellow and dark ochre slime with brown-amber clots and depths and pale cream wet highlights, one dented grey steel helmet half sunk in its top.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing; one grey steel helmet is half sunk in the top of the heap.
pose: The heap pours to the left, its front bulging forward with the one thick blunt arm of slime reared up at the left and curling over to slap down, the rest slumped and dragging behind at the right, the steel helmet tilted on top.
must_show: one lumpy sagging heap of dull mustard-yellow slime, uneven lobes
one thick blunt arm of slime rearing up at the front
a grey steel helmet half sunk in it
wet, cloudy, clotted painted slime with depth; no face at all

what: a spawn of Jormungandr, the world serpent of Norse myth: a young sea snake, one long, slim, smooth, plain serpent, a real snake drawn large. It has a narrow wedge-shaped snake's head with a blunt snout, small cold pale yellow eyes with slit pupils, and two long white fangs with a drop of pale green venom on each. Its scales are small, smooth and plain from head to tail, and its tail is a snake's simple pointed tail.
colours: dark sea-green and grey-green scales on the back with a faint darker zigzag, a pale grey-cream belly, pale yellow eyes, white fangs, pale green venom drops.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is a snake and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: its body lies in one single round loop with the front third reared up in an S curve, the head drawn back and then lunging to the left with the jaws wide open and both fangs showing, the pointed tail tip lifted at the right. It floats in empty air with nothing under it.
must_show: one slim plain legless serpent, reared from a single loop
dark sea-green scales, pale belly
open jaws with two fangs
plain: no horns, no spines, no fins, no crown
must_not_show: dragon head with a long snout

what: a young Jormungandr, the world serpent of Norse myth, already vast: one enormously thick, heavy, ancient-looking sea serpent whose body is as thick as a ship's hull. Its body winds in two great heavy coils, and crushed inside the lower coil is one small wooden Viking longship with a broken mast, gripped like a toy and no longer than the serpent's own head. Its head is a great broad blunt serpent's head with a heavy armoured brow, two thick backswept dark horns, a fringe of thick fleshy barbels hanging under its chin like a beard, cold glowing pale yellow eyes and long white fangs. A row of tall thick dark spines runs along its back from the head down the coils. Its scales are big, rough and plated like shields.
colours: very dark sea-green and iron-grey plated scales on the back, a pale grey-cream belly of broad plates, black horns and back spines, glowing pale yellow eyes, white fangs, a small puff of sickly yellow-green venom mist at the jaws, a small weathered brown wooden longship.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It has no limbs; exactly one small brown wooden longship is crushed in its lower coil. It holds nothing else.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: its body is heaped in two thick coils with the small longship crushed in the lower one, and the front of the body rears up tall in an S curve with the horned head at the upper left, jaws wide open, breathing one small thick puff of yellow-green venom mist that is joined to its mouth and no bigger than its own head. It floats in empty air with nothing under it.
must_show: one enormously thick legless serpent in heavy coils, head reared
a small wooden longship crushed in its coils, showing its vast size
horned head with a beard of barbels, and a row of spines down the back
very dark sea-green plated scales, pale belly
a small puff of yellow-green venom at the open jaws
far heavier, older and more armed than the plain spawn

what: a dread knight: a dead fallen paladin, the lowest rank of the undead knights, a tall lean warrior standing on two legs in a plain suit of soot-black iron plate armour with nothing of him showing. His head is entirely inside a plain closed bucket-shaped helm with a flat top and one narrow eye slit; the slit is pitch dark except for two small dull red points of light. The armour is plain, dull and unadorned, the black iron drinking the light, with dents and scratches. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, wide shoulders, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: dull soot-black iron plate armour with dark grey scratched edges, two small dull red eye lights in a black eye slit, a ragged charcoal-grey tabard, a plain sword with a dark grey iron blade, a plain black iron shield with a dark grey rim.
wears: He wears a plain full suit of dull soot-black iron plate armour from head to foot: a plain flat-topped closed helm with one narrow eye slit and nothing on it, plain rounded shoulder plates, gauntlets and greaves. Over the breastplate hangs a short ragged charcoal-grey tabard with no emblem. He has no cape.
holds: He holds exactly one plain straight sword in his right hand, with a dark grey iron blade and a simple cross-guard; the blade does not glow. On his left arm he carries exactly one plain black iron shield, pointed at the bottom, with no emblem.
pose: He advances to the left on two legs with one foot forward and knees bent, the plain black shield held up before his body on his left arm, his right arm drawn back with the sword raised level beside his helm, point forward, ready to thrust.
must_show: plain soot-black plate armour, no flesh or bone showing
plain flat-topped closed helm, dark eye slit with two dull red lights
one plain dark sword in the right hand, not glowing
one plain black shield on the left arm
no cape, no horns, no ornament: the plainest of the dark knights

what: a demon knight: a paladin who sold himself to Hell, a tall, broad, powerful warrior standing on two legs in a full suit of heavy black plate armour whose seams and joints glow dull red-orange from the heat inside, with nothing of him showing. His head is entirely inside a closed black helm with a narrow eye slit that burns bright orange, and two thick curved black horns rise from the sides of the helm, sweeping up. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, wide shoulders, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: black plate armour with dark crimson enamelled edges and dull red-orange glowing seams, a bright orange burning eye slit, two black horns on the helm, a tattered dark crimson cape, a sword blade wrapped in orange and yellow flame, a black iron shield with a dark crimson rim.
wears: He wears a full suit of heavy black plate armour from head to foot with dark crimson enamelled edges: a closed helm with a burning orange eye slit and two thick curved black horns, big spiked shoulder plates, clawed gauntlets and greaves. A short tattered dark crimson cape hangs from his shoulders.
holds: He holds exactly one long straight sword in his right hand, its whole thick broad blade wrapped in bright orange and yellow flame from hilt to tip. On his left arm he carries exactly one black iron shield, pointed at the bottom, with a dark crimson rim and one short iron spike in its centre.
pose: He advances to the left on two legs with one foot forward and knees bent, the spiked black shield held up before his body on his left arm in a trained guard, his right arm raised with the flaming sword lifted high above his horned helm for a downward cut.
must_show: heavy black plate armour with glowing red-orange seams, no flesh showing
closed helm with two curved black horns and a burning orange eye slit
one sword with a flaming blade in the right hand
one black spiked shield on the left arm
short crimson cape: grander and more hellish than the plain dread knight

what: a veteran knight: a living human knight of about fifty, thirty years a campaigner, a tall, strong, broad-shouldered man standing on two legs in a full suit of fine, well-kept, polished steel plate armour. His head is bare and his face shows plainly: a hard, weather-beaten, lined face with a broken nose, a scar down one cheek, cropped iron-grey hair and a short iron-grey beard, eyes narrowed and unimpressed. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, wide shoulders, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: polished pale steel plate armour with darker steel shadows and worn brass buckles, a weather-beaten light tan face, iron-grey hair and beard, a faded dark crimson surcoat, a brown leather sword belt, a bright steel sword, a shield painted dark crimson with one broad white stripe.
wears: He wears a full suit of masterwork polished steel plate armour from neck to foot: a fitted breastplate, layered shoulder plates, arm plates, gauntlets, leg plates and steel shoes, over a mail collar. Over the breastplate hangs a faded dark crimson surcoat belted with brown leather. His head is bare: he wears no helmet.
holds: He holds exactly one straight steel longsword in his right hand, with a plain cross-guard and a bright blade. On his left arm he carries exactly one knight's shield, flat at the top and pointed at the bottom, painted dark crimson with one broad white stripe slanting across it.
pose: He advances to the left on two legs with one foot forward and knees bent, the crimson shield held up before his body on his left arm, his right arm bent with the longsword held high and angled forward over the shield's top edge, ready to cut, his grey-bearded face turned to the left, jaw set.
must_show: a living grey-bearded human man, bare head, face plainly seen
polished steel plate armour, clean and well kept
one steel longsword in the right hand
one crimson shield with a white stripe on the left arm
a mortal knight, plainly not undead or demonic

what: a grave knight: a knight long dead who has climbed out of his cairn to keep an oath, a tall gaunt skeleton standing on two legs inside a suit of ancient plate armour that has rusted through. His head is a bare weathered bone skull, yellowed and earth-stained, with an open jaw and two cold pale white points of light deep in the dark eye sockets; over the skull sits an open-faced rusted helm with a broken rim. Every plate of the armour is old dark iron eaten by rust: a very dark brown, the colour of an old iron nail or a ship's anchor, nearly black in the shadows, with dull dark red-brown patches, pitted and flaking, with a few holes eaten through. He has no flesh at all. He has realistic adult proportions: a small skull, wide shoulders, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: very dark brown rusted iron plate armour, the colour of an old nail, nearly black in the shadows with dull dark red-brown patches and black pits, a yellowed earth-stained bone skull, two cold pale white eye lights, a tattered earth-grey burial shroud worn as a cloak, patches of dull olive grave moss, a greatsword with a dark grey-brown pitted iron blade.
wears: He wears a full suit of ancient plate armour, very dark brown rusted iron on every plate: an open-faced helm with a broken rim that leaves the whole skull face showing, a breastplate, dented shoulder plates, gauntlets and greaves, all whole enough to cover his body. A long tattered earth-grey burial shroud hangs from his shoulders as a cloak, and dull olive moss grows on one shoulder plate.
holds: He grips exactly one great two-handed sword with both gauntleted hands together on its long grip, one fist above the other: a very long, broad, heavy blade of dark grey-brown pitted iron with a notched edge and a wide cross-guard. He has no shield and holds nothing else.
pose: He strides to the left on two legs with a long step, front knee bent, leaning forward; both of his arms are lifted to his right and both gauntlets grip the long sword grip together, one fist above the other, the great dark sword swung up high over his right shoulder with the blade slanting up and back behind his helm, about to chop down; his skull is thrust forward with the jaw wide open, pronouncing doom, shroud streaming back to the right.
must_show: a bare skull face under an open rusted helm, readable in the small sprite
plate armour of very dark brown rusted iron on every plate, pitted, dark not orange
one long rusted greatsword held in both hands, no shield
tattered grey shroud-cloak
older and more ruined than the black dread knight, with a far bigger sword
must_not_show: bare rib cage with no breastplate
sword held out in one hand
leather tunic with no plate armour

what: the Green Knight of Arthurian legend: a giant of a knight, enormously tall, lean-waisted, deep-chested and very wide in the shoulders, a warrior in his prime standing on two legs, and green all over. His skin is deep leaf-green on his face, neck and hands alike, as green as a leaf, with no pink and no tan anywhere. He has a proud, fierce, wild face, red eyes, and a huge bushy beard and long thick wild hair of bright grass-green that spread over his chest and shoulders like a bush. His head is bare, crowned only with a wreath of dark holly leaves with red berries. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, very wide shoulders, long legs, about eight heads tall.
colours: deep leaf-green skin on face and hands, bright grass-green hair and beard, a dark emerald-green breastplate, arm plates and leg plates edged with dull gold, a dark emerald-green tunic, a gold belt, a long dark green mantle, a dark holly wreath with red berries, an axe with a dark green haft and one huge pale steel blade.
wears: He wears a warrior lord's war gear, all dark green with a little dull gold: a dark emerald-green breastplate, arm plates and leg plates edged with dull gold over a dark emerald-green tunic to his knees, a wide gold belt, and a long dark green mantle hanging from his shoulders and swept back. On his bare head sits a wreath of dark holly leaves with red berries. He wears no helmet.
holds: He grips exactly one enormous woodsman's axe with both fists close together on its haft, swinging it: a long thick dark green haft, and at its top one huge pale steel blade on one side only, shaped like a broad crescent as long as his forearm; the other side of the haft is bare wood. He holds nothing else.
pose: He strides to the left on two legs with a long step, front knee bent, his body twisted, both arms lifted to his right with both fists on the haft and the great axe swung back high over his right shoulder, its single blade behind and above his head, about to chop down, green beard and hair flying, mouth open in a roar of laughter, mantle streaming back to the right.
must_show: a giant knight green all over: green skin on the face, green hair and a huge green beard
bare head with a holly wreath, face plainly seen
dark green armour edged with gold, green mantle
one enormous axe with a single broad blade, both hands on the haft, swung back
striding and swinging: a lord of legend, not a standing statue
must_not_show: axe stood on the ground like a staff

what: a rider of the dread knight legion: one dead knight in full soot-black plate armour, mounted on a horse made wholly of bare bones, charging with a lance. The rider is tall and wide-shouldered with nothing of him showing: his head is entirely inside a closed flat-topped black helm with one narrow eye slit lit by two dull red points of light, and from the top of the helm streams a long ragged black horsehair plume. The horse is a real horse's skeleton and nothing else: a long bare horse skull with empty eye sockets, a curved neck of big separate neck bones, an open cage of thick ribs with dark gaps between them, and four long bare leg bones ending in hooves, all yellowed ivory bone with no flesh and no skin. Tattered black cloth trappings hang from its back under the saddle.
colours: soot-black iron plate armour with dark grey scratched edges on the rider, two dull red eye lights, a ragged black plume, a yellowed ivory-bone skeleton horse with dark gaps between its bones, tattered black saddle cloth with a dull silver border, a long black lance with a grey iron point and a ragged dark crimson pennon, a black iron shield with a dull silver rim.
wears: The rider wears a full suit of soot-black iron plate armour from head to foot with a closed flat-topped helm, a long ragged black plume and a short ragged black cape. The skeleton horse wears a black saddle and tattered black saddle cloth with a dull silver border.
holds: The rider holds exactly one long thick black lance couched under his right arm, levelled and pointing to the left past the horse's skull, with a grey iron point and one ragged dark crimson pennon tied behind the point. On his left arm he carries exactly one black iron shield with a dull silver rim. He holds nothing else.
pose: Seen from the side in full profile, facing left: the skeleton horse gallops to the left with its front leg bones flung forward and its hind leg bones stretched back, all four hooves off the ground and nothing beneath it; the black rider sits upright in the saddle leaning forward, lance levelled to the left, shield on his left arm, plume and cape streaming back to the right.
must_show: one black-armoured knight riding a horse, seen from the side
the horse is a bare skeleton: skull, ribs with gaps, leg bones
one long lance levelled forward with a ragged pennon
closed black helm with a plume, red eye lights
a mounted charger: the only knight on horseback, the top of the dark knights
must_not_show: living horse with flesh and hide
horse in plate armour hiding the bones
bare skull face on the rider
cloud of mist round the legs

what: a kobold dragonshield: a small reptilian creature like a little upright lizard, stockier and squarer than a common kobold, with a long snout full of small teeth, small backswept horns, stubborn narrowed yellow eyes and a thin tail. It stands on two legs behind a shield nearly as tall as itself.
colours: rust-orange and tan scales on its own skin, a pale belly, heavy armour plates and a shield of dark blood-red dragon scale with black edges, dark brown leather straps, a spear with a brown wooden shaft and a pale ivory point.
wears: It wears heavy armour made of big overlapping dark blood-red dragon scales, each scale as big as its hand, laced together with dark leather: a coat of them over its chest and belly and two big scale plates on its shoulders. Its head is bare.
holds: On its left arm it carries exactly one very big shield made from a single huge dark blood-red dragon scale, shaped like a pointed leaf with a ridge down the middle, covering it from chin to shin. In its right hand it holds exactly one short thick spear with a brown wooden shaft and a broad pale ivory point, pointing to the left over the top of the shield.
pose: It stands braced on two legs facing left with its feet planted wide and knees bent, the big red scale shield set in front of its body, the short spear levelled over the shield's top edge and jabbing to the left, snout lifted proudly, tail stiff behind for balance.
must_show: kobold (small upright lizard: snout, small horns, tail, orange-tan scales)
armour of big overlapping dark red dragon scales
one very big red scale shield in front of the body
one short spear over the shield
planted and stubborn, heavier than a common kobold

what: a kobold pack leader: the oldest survivor of the warren, a small, lean, wiry reptilian creature like a little upright lizard standing on two legs, with a long snout, sharp clever yellow eyes, and a thin tail. He is old and scarred: one of his two backswept horns is broken off short, three pale claw scars cross his snout, and the scales of his muzzle have faded to grey.
colours: dull rust-orange and tan scales faded to grey on the muzzle, a pale belly, a ragged dark red dragon-hide cloak, dark brown leather harness, a bright brass whistle on a brown thong, an axe with a brown wooden handle and a big pale ivory tooth for a blade.
wears: He wears a leader's ragged cloak of dark red dragon hide over his shoulders, pinned with a bone pin, a dark brown leather harness across his chest hung with a few small ivory teeth, and round his neck a leather thong.
holds: In his right hand he holds exactly one hand axe: a short thick brown wooden handle with one huge curved pale ivory dragon tooth, as long as his forearm, lashed across its top as the blade. In his left hand he holds exactly one short thick bright brass whistle, shaped like a little tube, lifted to the tip of his snout and blown, its thong looped round his neck.
pose: He stands on two legs turned to the left, feet apart, his left hand lifted holding the brass whistle to the end of his snout, blowing it, cheeks puffed, his right arm raised with the tooth axe held high and pointing forward to send the pack in, cloak swinging, tail up.
must_show: kobold (small upright lizard: snout, tail, orange-tan scales)
old and scarred: grey muzzle, one broken horn
an axe whose blade is one big pale tooth, in the right hand
a brass whistle held to the snout in the left hand
dark red hide cloak: a leader, more than the dragonshield

what: the Cow King: the war-king of the hell cattle, a massive, heavy, grim beast-warrior standing upright on two legs. He has the head of a real bull, painted as a real animal: a broad heavy muzzle with wide nostrils, small fierce dark red eyes under a heavy brow, drooping ears, and two long forward-curving horns covered in bright gold. His whole body is covered in short cattle hide in big bold patches of black and white, like a dairy bull: the head, thick neck, deep chest, belly, thick arms and legs alike. His legs are an upright bull's hind legs ending in two big black cloven hooves. His hands are thick three-fingered fists. He is a painted, weathered, fearsome war-beast with a small head for his enormous shoulders.
colours: short cattle hide in big black and white patches on every part, a pink-grey muzzle, dark red eyes, two bright gold horns, a tall gold crown, a long faded dusty-purple cape with a worn ermine-white collar, a wide dark brown leather war belt with a gold buckle, black hooves, a halberd with a dark wooden shaft and a bright steel head.
wears: He wears a tall heavy gold crown with square points set between his gold horns, a long faded dusty-purple royal cape with a worn white fur collar hanging from his shoulders to his hooves, and a wide dark brown leather war belt with a big gold buckle and a hanging leather war skirt to his knees. His chest and arms are covered in his own black and white hide.
holds: He grips exactly one royal halberd in both fists, both hands on its shaft: a thick dark wooden shaft taller than himself, and at its top a bright steel head with one broad axe blade on one side, a hooked spike on the other side and a long spear point on top. He holds nothing else.
pose: He stands upright on his two hoofed legs with hooves planted wide, turned a little to the left, body leaning forward, the halberd held slantwise across his body in both fists with its steel head high at the upper left, about to chop down, head lowered so the gold horns point forward, nostrils flared, bellowing.
must_show: an upright bull-headed beast-warrior on two hoofed legs
black and white patched cattle hide all over
gold horns and a gold crown
faded purple royal cape
one halberd (axe blade, hook and spear point on a long shaft) held in both hands
grim and kingly, not a joke
must_not_show: plain axe with no spear point

what: Surtur, lord of the fire giants of Norse myth, who will burn the world at Ragnarok: a colossal, enormously broad, mountain-chested giant standing on two legs. His skin is black cooled lava rock on his face, chest, arms and legs alike, and it is split all over by a net of deep cracks that glow molten yellow-orange from the fire inside him. His hair and his long beard are real fire: tall bright flames standing up from his scalp and streaming down from his jaw. His eyes are two white-hot points. From his brow rise two great thick black horns that curve up and outward. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, enormously wide shoulders, thick limbs, about seven heads tall.
colours: black lava-rock skin split by glowing molten yellow-orange cracks on every part, hair and beard of bright orange and yellow flame, white-hot eyes, two great black horns, black iron shoulder plates and a black iron belt with dull gold edges, a ragged charred-black kilt of iron scales, a sword with a blade of blinding white-yellow fire.
wears: He wears little, for his own burning rock is his armour: two great jagged black iron shoulder plates edged with dull gold, a wide black iron belt with a plain round dull gold buckle, a ragged kilt of charred black iron scales to his knees, and black iron bracers. His chest is bare black cracked rock. His head is bare but for his own two horns and his hair of flame.
holds: He grips exactly one colossal straight sword in both hands, both fists on its long black hilt: a very broad, very long blade made of blinding white-yellow fire from the cross-guard to the tip, brighter than everything else in the picture, with short flames along both edges. He holds nothing else.
pose: He stands on two legs with his feet planted wide, turned a little to the left, the great burning sword held upright in both fists before his right shoulder with its point high above his head, about to sweep down, his horned head lowered and glaring, flame beard streaming to the right.
must_show: a giant with black rock skin split by glowing molten cracks all over
hair and beard of real flame, two great black horns
one colossal sword with a blade of white-yellow fire, held in both hands
black iron shoulder plates, bare cracked chest
the most terrible of all fire giants: greater than the crowned fire giant king
must_not_show: body hidden in a cloud of flame

what: Tiamat, the five-headed queen of dragons: one enormous, heavy, ancient dragon that walks on all four legs like a huge lizard, with one massive body and five long thick necks growing side by side from its one pair of shoulders. The five necks spread apart like the five fingers of an open hand, and each ends in one horned dragon's head with open jaws; each head is a different colour. From top to bottom the five heads are: a bone-white head, a bright red head, a golden-yellow head, a dark green head and a coal-black head. Each head wears a crown of long backswept horns. The body has a deep chest, four thick clawed legs, a long heavy spiked tail, and two great dark bat-like wings.
colours: a body of dark crimson-brown scales with a pale bone-yellow plated belly; five heads and necks coloured bone-white, bright red, golden-yellow, dark green and coal-black; pale ivory horns and claws; glowing yellow eyes; dark crimson-brown wings with black membranes.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing; the crowns are horns growing from each skull.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: it stands with all four of its feet planted on the ground and its body horizontal, the two wings raised straight up above its back; the five necks fan out to the left from the shoulders, the white head highest, then the red, the yellow, the green, and the black head lowest near the ground, all five heads facing left with jaws open, roaring; the spiked tail curls up at the right.
must_show: one dragon body on four legs, seen from the side, body horizontal
five necks fanned out like fingers, each with a dragon head
the heads in different colours: white, red, yellow, green, black
horned crowned heads, jaws open
wings and a spiked tail: the queen of dragons, vast and ancient

what: Asmodeus, Prince of Hell: a tall, lean, upright, kingly devil standing on two legs, calm and terrible, who rules by contract. His skin is deep blood-red on his face and hands alike. He has a long, handsome, cruel face with high cheekbones, a thin cold smile, a neat pointed black beard, slicked-back black hair, and eyes that glow pale gold. Two long black horns rise from his brow and sweep back in a smooth curve. Behind him rise two great black bat wings. He has realistic adult proportions: a small head, wide shoulders, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: deep blood-red skin, black hair and pointed beard, pale gold glowing eyes, two long black horns, long black robes with a wide gold border and a dark crimson lining, a gold breastplate collar and wide gold belt, a thin gold crown with a red gem, two great black bat wings with dark crimson membranes, a gold rod topped with one big bright red ruby, a cream parchment scroll with a red wax seal.
wears: He wears the robes of a prince: long black robes to the floor with a wide gold embroidered border and dark crimson lining, long sleeves, a broad ornate gold collar across his shoulders and chest, a wide gold belt, and a thin gold crown with one red gem set between his horns.
holds: In his right fist he holds exactly one short heavy gold sceptre, raised high: a thick gold bar no longer than his forearm and as thick as his wrist, gripped at its lower end so that it stands up from his fist beside his horns, topped with one big bright red ruby the size of his fist. The sceptre is short, like a king's mace, and comes nowhere near the ground. In his left hand he holds exactly one rolled cream parchment contract, as thick as his arm, with one big round red wax seal hanging from it, thrust out forward.
pose: He steps to the left on two legs with one foot forward under the robe, leaning forward, his left arm stretched out ahead holding the sealed parchment out to be signed, his right arm bent with the short ruby sceptre raised high beside his head like a judge's hammer about to fall, chin up, smiling coldly, both black wings raised and spread behind his shoulders.
must_show: a tall red-skinned devil prince with long black horns and a black pointed beard
rich black and gold robes, gold collar, thin gold crown
a short thick gold sceptre topped with a big red ruby, raised in the right hand, not touching the ground
a rolled parchment with a red seal in the left hand
two black bat wings spread behind
regal, calm and imposing: the greatest of the devils
must_not_show: long wizard's staff touching the ground
tall staff as long as his body
standing still facing the viewer with arms down

what: a leprechaun of Irish folk tale: a solitary fairy shoemaker, a very short, stocky, wizened old man no taller than a man's knee, standing on two legs, painted seriously as a real weather-beaten old craftsman. He is built short and broad like a dwarf: a big barrel chest, short thick bowed legs, big knotted hands. He has a lined, leathery, sharp-nosed face with deep creases, one eye narrowed in a sly wink, bushy brows, and a huge full curly beard and side-whiskers of bright rust-red that reach his belt. His ears are slightly pointed.
colours: a weather-beaten light tan face, a big bright rust-red beard, a worn emerald-green tailcoat and emerald-green knee breeches with dull brass buttons, a narrow dark brown leather belt, cream wool stockings, black shoes with big square brass buckles, a tall battered emerald-green hat with a black band and a big square brass buckle, a small hammer with a wooden handle and a dark iron head, one black leather shoe with a brass buckle.
wears: He wears old-fashioned clothes, worn and patched, green from hat to knee: a long emerald-green tailcoat with dull brass buttons, emerald-green knee breeches, a narrow dark brown belt, cream wool stockings, black shoes with big square brass buckles, and a tall battered emerald-green hat with a black band and one big square brass buckle on its front.
holds: In his right hand he holds exactly one small cobbler's hammer: a short wooden handle with a small dark iron head, raised beside his hat. In his left hand he holds exactly one black leather shoe with a brass buckle, a whole shoe with a heel and a toe, held up by its heel in front of his chest.
pose: He stands on two legs, turned to the left but glancing back sideways at the viewer with one eye narrowed in a wink, the shoe held up in his left hand before his chest and the small hammer lifted in his right hand above it, about to tap, one foot forward as if about to slip away.
must_show: a very short stocky wizened old man with a big rust-red beard, painted seriously
green coat, green breeches and a tall green hat with a brass buckle
a small hammer in the right hand
one whole shoe in the left hand
sly winking look
must_not_show: garden gnome with a pointed red hat
pointed elf ears as long as his head

what: a lesser basilisk: a young basilisk, a thin, slender, small snake, a real snake drawn large, with a narrow flat head. On top of its head stand three short, stubby, blunt white horn nubs in a row, the first buds of a crown, each no taller than its eye is wide. It has round glowing pale yellow eyes with slit pupils and two short fangs. Its scales are small and smooth.
colours: dull olive-green scales with faint darker olive banding, a pale yellow belly, three small bone-white horn nubs on the head, glowing pale yellow eyes.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is a snake and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side: its thin body lies in one single small coil with the front half reared up in an S curve, head turned to the left, neck drawn back to strike, mouth open showing its short fangs, yellow eyes staring. It floats in empty air with nothing under it.
must_show: a thin young legless serpent reared from one coil
three short white horn nubs on the head, a crown just beginning
glowing pale yellow eyes
dull olive-green, slimmer and plainer than the full basilisk
must_not_show: tall crown of five long horn points
row of spikes down the neck
bright emerald with bold black bands

what: a lesser phase spider: a young phase spider, a real spider drawn large with the true body of a spider: a small head section, a small narrow oval abdomen, and exactly eight long, very thin, jointed legs. It is leaner and plainer than a full phase spider: its whole body and legs are a pale, cold, icy blue, the blue of a winter sky, with two broad white bands across the abdomen and white leg joints. It is solid and clearly drawn except for the very end of its abdomen, which thins out into two or three short wisps of pale mist.
colours: pale icy sky-blue body and legs with darker steel-blue shadows, two broad white bands on the abdomen and white leg joints, small bright cyan eyes, a little pale blue-white mist at the rear tip. No green anywhere.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the front and slightly above, it crouches low with its legs planted wide to both sides and its two front legs lifted and reaching forward, fangs open, about to hop.
must_show: a true spider body with eight long thin legs, solid and clear
pale icy blue with a couple of white bands, blue not green
small cyan eyes
just the rear tip fading into a little mist
smaller in the abdomen and plainer than the full phase spider
must_not_show: cloud of mist around the body
many bold stripes all over every leg

what: a lesser will-o'-the-wisp, the foolish fire of the marshes: one single small floating flame of cold ghost-light, painted as real fire, soft and glowing like the flame of burning marsh gas. It is a teardrop of flame, round at the bottom and drawn up to flickering points at the top: a round bright white-hot core at its heart, a body of pale ghostly sky-blue fire around the core, and deeper blue at its soft edges, with three or four flickering pointed tongues of flame rising from its top and one short curling wisp of fading blue fire trailing beneath it. It is only fire, soft-edged and bright: a cold, lonely marsh light.
colours: a white-hot core, pale ghostly sky-blue flame around it deepening to bright azure blue at the soft edges and the trailing wisp. No green, no yellow, no brown.
wears: It wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing.
pose: It drifts to the left through empty air, its flame leaning that way, the tongues at its top bent back to the right and its short wisp of fire curling down and behind.
must_show: one small floating flame with a bright white core
pale ghost-blue fire, painted as real soft flame with depth
a short trailing wisp of fire below
no face at all

what: a lesser Erinyes, one of the Furies who hound oath-breakers: a tall, lean, strong, winged woman warrior of Hell standing on two legs. She has a fair, stern, cold, beautiful face with pale skin, dark brows drawn down in judgement, dark red eyes, and long straight black hair tied back. Two great wings of black feathers grow from her back. She has realistic adult proportions: a small head, long limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: pale ivory skin on the face and hands, long black hair, two black feathered wings, a long dark crimson tunic, a plain dull olive-green sash across the chest, dark brown leather boots and belt, a sword with a dull steel blade stained dark green along the edge, one thick coil of tan rope.
wears: She wears plain soldier's clothes and is fully clothed: a long-sleeved dark crimson tunic with a high neck, its skirt hanging to her shins, one plain dull olive-green sash across her chest, a brown leather belt and tall brown leather boots. Her head is bare. She has no armour.
holds: She holds exactly one straight longsword in her right hand, its dull steel blade stained dark green along the edge. In her left hand she holds exactly one thick tan rope, as thick as her thumb: a coil of three big loops in her fist with one short end hanging down, tied in a noose.
pose: She strides to the left on two legs with one foot forward, the sword raised in her right hand above her shoulder to cut, her left hand thrust out ahead gripping the coil of thick rope ready to throw, both black wings raised behind her, face stern, mouth closed.
must_show: a winged woman warrior, fully clothed, with a fair stern face
two black feathered wings
long dark crimson tunic with a plain sash, no armour
one sword in the right hand
a thick coil of rope in the left hand
plain gear, bare head: a lesser Fury

what: a lesser death: a small reaper sent for one soul, a thin, short, stooped figure in a plain ragged hooded robe that ends in tatters at the shins; two thin bare bone feet dangle beneath the torn hem, off the ground, so that it hangs in the air. Inside the deep hood is a bare yellowed bone skull with dark empty eye sockets and a closed lipless jaw. Its two hands are bare bone, thin finger bones with no flesh. It has realistic proportions: a small skull, narrow shoulders, long thin arms.
colours: a plain ragged charcoal-grey and black hooded robe with frayed pale grey edges, a yellowed ivory bone skull and bone hands, black eye sockets, a rope belt of dull tan, a scythe with a plain dark brown wooden shaft and a dull grey iron blade.
wears: It wears one plain, coarse, ragged charcoal-grey hooded robe with long torn sleeves, the hood drawn up over the skull, tied at the waist with a tan rope. It wears nothing else: no armour, no crown, no ornament.
holds: It grips exactly one plain scythe in both bone hands, both hands on the shaft: a long, thick, slightly crooked dark brown wooden shaft with one long curved dull grey iron blade fixed across its top end, the blade as long as its arm and drawn thick and bold. It holds nothing else.
pose: It drifts to the left through the air, stooped forward, the scythe drawn back over its right shoulder in both bone hands with the curved blade high behind its hood, about to sweep, the skull tilted down and forward, the ragged hem of the robe trailing back to the right.
must_show: a hooded ragged dark robe with a bare skull inside the hood
bone hands
one plain scythe with a curved blade, held in both hands
the robe ending in tatters with bone feet dangling, drifting off the ground
small and plain: no wings, no crown, no armour
must_not_show: cloud of mist around the body

what: a lesser thunderbird: a smaller cousin of the Thunderbird of North American legend, a real bird of prey like a great storm-coloured eagle, drawn large. It has a heavy hooked beak, a flat fierce head with a stern brow and no crest, two eyes that glow bright yellow like lightning, broad powerful wings, a fan tail, and big feet with black talons. Short bright yellow jagged sparks of lightning crawl along the edges of its wing feathers and snap between its talons.
colours: dark storm-grey and charcoal feathers on the back and wings, a paler ash-grey chest barred with dark grey, a dull yellow beak with a black tip, glowing bright yellow eyes, dull yellow feet with black talons, short bright yellow zigzag lightning sparks.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is a bird and holds nothing; both taloned feet are empty and open.
pose: Seen from the side, it swoops to the left with nothing beneath it, both broad wings raised high above its back in a V, both taloned feet thrust forward and spread to strike with short yellow sparks between the talons, head thrust forward, beak open in a scream, tail fanned.
must_show: a real bird of prey: hooked beak, broad feathered wings, talons
dark storm-grey feathers
glowing yellow eyes
short bright yellow lightning sparks on the wings and talons, touching the bird
swooping, talons forward
must_not_show: ram or prey in its talons
long lightning bolts running off the picture

what: a lesser sphinx: a young guardian sphinx of the Egyptian kind, a living monster on four legs: the head of a human man on the body of a lean big cat. Its head is a real human head, as large as the cat's whole chest: the lean, sharp, clean-shaven, impatient face of a young Egyptian man with smooth bronze-brown human skin, a straight human nose, thin human lips, a firm human chin, human ears, and two dark human eyes lined with black under straight black brows. The head wears a plain headcloth of undyed cream linen that covers the hair and hangs in two plain flaps down to the chest. Below the chin the human neck joins the furred shoulders, and from there back it is all animal: a narrow chest, long legs, paws with claws, and a long tail with a dark tuft, covered in short dull sandy-tan fur.
colours: short dull sandy-tan lion's fur on the body with a cream belly, a dark brown tail tuft, a bronze-brown human face, a plain cream linen headcloth with one thin dark brown band at the brow, dark eyes.
wears: It wears only a plain cream linen headcloth with one thin dark brown band at the brow. It wears nothing else: no collar, no gold, no beard.
holds: It is a beast on four legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, its body facing left, it crouches low on four legs like a cat about to pounce, hindquarters raised, chest low, one front paw lifted off the ground with the claws out, tail curled up behind; its man's head is turned to face the viewer so the whole human face shows, one brow raised, the human mouth open, speaking its riddle sharply.
must_show: a lean lion's body on four legs, seen from the side
one human man's face (nose, lips, chin, bronze skin, no muzzle) in a plain cream headcloth, readable in the small sprite
no wings, no gold, no collar
crouched to pounce, one paw lifted
leaner and plainer than the gold-collared sphinx guardian
must_not_show: gold and deep blue striped headcloth
woman's face with long black hair

what: a lesser stone golem: a smaller, cruder guardian of the same kind as the great stone golems, a statue of a helmeted sentinel that the masons only roughed out of one block of grey granite and never finished, come to life. Every part of it is rough speckled granite. It is a carving of armour, not of a body: it shows no muscles and no skin. Its head is a plain rounded stone helm, a simple granite dome with two narrow dark carved eye slots and nothing else. Its chest is one plain slab-sided granite block, still showing the flat cuts of the quarry and rows of chisel grooves. Its arms are plain thick granite pillars ending in heavy mitten-shaped stone fists with no fingers cut. Its legs are two short thick stone pillars on flat stone feet. The stone is rough and unpolished everywhere: chisel grooves, chipped corners, one long crack across the chest, and dark seams at the shoulders, elbows, waist and knees. It has a small head for its body and is narrower in the shoulders than a great stone golem.
colours: speckled mid-grey and dark charcoal-grey granite on every part with pale grey chipped edges and chisel grooves, black cracks, seams and eye slots; no other colour.
wears: It wears nothing over its stone: the plain helm shape is part of the same granite block.
holds: Its hands are empty and it holds nothing: two heavy fingerless granite fists.
pose: It trudges to the left on two legs with a heavy step, front knee bent, both stone fists raised together high above its helm to slam straight down, its body leaning forward into the blow.
must_show: a figure of rough grey granite, every part stone
a plain domed stone helm-head with two dark eye slots, no face
plain unfinished blocks with chisel grooves: no carved breastplate band, no carved skirt
both fingerless stone fists raised to slam, empty
cruder and narrower than the great stone golem, but plainly the same kind

what: a lesser aboleth: a young one of an ancient race of deep-sea horrors, one long, heavy, slimy fish, a real primeval fish like a huge catfish crossed with an eel, drawn large. It has a broad, tall, blunt armoured head with a high flat forehead, a wide downturned mouth lined with small teeth, a thick body that tapers to a long flat eel's tail with a ragged fin along its top and bottom, and a low ridged fin down its back. Its face has no ordinary pair of eyes. Instead a column of three big round glowing red eyes runs straight down the middle of its high forehead, one above another: the top eye near the crown of its head, the second eye directly beneath it, the third eye directly beneath that, just above the mouth. The three eyes are the same size, each as big as a fist, bright red, and they touch nothing but the dark skin between them. From just behind its head grow four long thick tentacles, like the arms of an octopus without suckers, that trail and coil. Its skin is wet and glistening with slime.
colours: dark murky olive-grey skin on the back mottled with black, a pale sickly grey-cream belly, three bright red eyes, dark olive-grey tentacles with pale grey-cream undersides, wet pale highlights, strings of pale grey-green slime hanging from the tentacles.
wears: It is a beast and wears nothing.
holds: It holds nothing; its tentacles are empty.
pose: Its long body swims to the left through empty air in a slow S curve with nothing under it, but its big head is turned to face the viewer, so that the whole forehead shows with the column of three red eyes one above another down its middle, the mouth open beneath them; two tentacles reach forward and two trail back along its body, and the eel tail curves up at the right.
must_show: one long heavy fish with an eel's tail
three red eyes in a column, one above another, down the middle of the forehead, readable in the small sprite
long thick tentacles growing from behind the head
dark olive-grey slimy skin, pale belly
a grim primeval fish, not a friendly one
must_not_show: two ordinary eyes at the sides of the head
bony armour plates and spikes all over
eyes side by side in a level row

what: a lesser behir: a young behir, a very long, low, snake-bodied reptile that runs on twelve legs, a real beast seen from the side. Its body is one very long thick serpent's body, as long as three crocodiles nose to tail, the same thickness all the way along, carried close to the ground. Six short, sturdy, clawed lizard legs show along its near side, evenly spaced like the oars of a galley: the first leg just behind the neck, then a second, a third, a fourth and a fifth leg one after another along the middle of the long body, and the sixth leg at the hips where the tail begins. Between every two legs there is a stretch of scaled body. It has a long narrow crocodile-like head with a mouth full of teeth, a smooth hornless skull, and a long tapering tail. A row of broad banded plates runs along its belly.
colours: deep sapphire-blue scales on the back and legs with darker navy bands, a pale grey-blue plated belly, black claws, yellow eyes, one short bright yellow zigzag spark of lightning at the jaws.
wears: It is an animal and wears nothing.
holds: It is a beast on many legs and holds nothing.
pose: Seen from the side, facing left: it runs to the left with its very long body stretched right across the picture in a low shallow wave, horizontal, nothing beneath it, the row of six short legs showing along its side from neck to hips, some reaching forward and some pushing back, head low and thrust forward with the jaws wide open and one short thick bright yellow zigzag spark of lightning shooting straight out of its mouth, joined to the mouth and no longer than its head, the tail curving up at the right.

six short clawed legs in a row along the near side, from neck to hips: many more legs than a crocodile
sapphire-blue scales, paler belly
crocodile-like head, no horns yet: a young one
a short yellow lightning spark at the open jaws
must_not_show: long lightning bolt running off the picture
ordinary crocodile with two front legs and two back legs

what: a lesser nalfeshnee: a judge-demon of the Abyss, an enormously fat, heavy, hulking beast standing upright on two legs. Its head is the head of a wild boar, a real hog's head: a long narrow bristly snout that sticks far out in front of its face and ends in a flat round disc of a nose with two nostrils, small mean yellow eyes set far back, ragged pointed upright ears, and two big curved ivory tusks rising from the corners of its lower jaw beside the snout. It has a vast sagging belly, a thick hump of shoulders, and two very long thick shaggy arms that hang to its knees and end in big hands with black claws. Its two legs are a boar's short hind legs ending in black cloven hooves. Its whole body is covered in coarse dark shaggy fur like a wild boar's bristles: the snout, head, chest, the whole round belly, arms and legs alike are furred, with no bare skin anywhere. From its shoulder blades grow two small, shabby feathered wings, each no bigger than its own head, far too small to lift it.
colours: coarse dark grey-brown bristly fur on every part including the whole belly, a dark grey snout with a paler grey disc nose, yellow eyes, ivory tusks, black claws and hooves, two small wings of dingy grey-white feathers, a wide dark leather belt with a dull iron buckle, a dark brown hide kilt.
wears: It wears only a wide dark leather belt with a dull iron buckle under its belly and a ragged dark brown hide kilt hanging from it to the knees. It has no armour and no crown.
holds: Its hands are empty and it holds nothing; both big clawed hands are open.
pose: It lumbers to the left on its two hoofed legs, leaning forward under its own weight, its right arm raised high with the claws spread to rake down and its left arm reaching forward, tusked head lowered, mouth open, the two small grey wings sticking up behind its shoulders.
must_show: an enormously fat upright beast with a real boar's head: long snout with a disc nose, big ivory tusks
long thick shaggy arms with clawed empty hands
dark bristly fur all over, belly included
two small feathered wings, far too small for the body
grim and heavy, not comic
must_not_show: bare orange or tan skin on the chest and belly

what: a lesser balor: a general of the demon armies, a towering, powerfully built, horned demon standing on two legs. Its skin is dark as charred wood, a deep red-black, on its face, chest, arms and legs alike. It has a brutal heavy-jawed face with a mouth of fangs, eyes that glow orange, and two thick black horns that curve out and forward from its temples like a bull's. Two dark bat wings grow from its back. It has realistic adult proportions: a small head, very wide shoulders, long thick limbs, about eight heads tall.
colours: deep red-black charred skin, glowing orange eyes, two black horns, two dark bat wings with dull dark red membranes, a black iron belt and a kilt of black iron plates, black iron bracers, a sword with a blade wrapped in orange and yellow flame, a whip made of orange and yellow flame.
wears: It wears a general's plain war gear: a wide black iron belt, a kilt of hanging black iron plates to its knees, black iron bracers and one plain black iron shoulder plate on its right shoulder. It has no helmet and no crown.
holds: In its right hand it holds exactly one great straight sword, its whole broad blade wrapped in bright orange and yellow flame from the guard to the tip. In its left hand it holds exactly one whip made of fire: a short thick black handle from which three thick cords of bright orange flame, each as thick as its finger, curl out in a loop no longer than its arm.
pose: It strides to the left on two legs with one foot forward, its right arm raised with the flaming sword lifted high over its horned head for a downward cut, its left arm swung out low ahead with the fire whip curling forward in a loop, wings half raised behind its shoulders, fanged mouth open roaring.
must_show: a horned demon with deep red-black skin and bat wings, on two legs
one sword with a flaming blade in the right hand
one whip of thick cords of flame in the left hand
black iron kilt and bracers, no crown
the fire is on the weapons: the body itself is not hidden in flame
must_not_show: body wrapped in a cloud of fire
glowing cracks all over the skin
long whip running off the picture
